name: Langton's Ant Colony
desc: A colony of Langton's ants crawls a coarse lattice, each turmite flipping cells by a section-drifting turn-rule and dragging a fading colored trail that tangles into churning chaos and bursts of diagonal highway order until the over-built grid collapses and reseeds, rendered as neon highways, green phosphor CRT, ink plotter, thermal visit-heatmap, or copper circuit traces.

density.doc: number of ants in the colony

hue.doc: base hue of the ant palette (spread by golden angle)
